title: Require Service Module Isolation
forbids: a non-test root module edge outside exact contract/router imports, including normalized-looking traversal; a root module re-export; a module relative import or re-export containing a parent segment outside the exact module.ts service-spine edge, the exact module-middleware createMiddleware edge, or one normalized named-router hop into its own module; a named-router owner import with an empty, dot, parent, or trailing segment; a current-owner alias containing an empty, dot, parent, or trailing segment; a direct current-owner module-tree alias naming a sibling; or a module reaching root runtime authority outside the admitted composition and middleware-authoring edges
why: The root composes completed module contracts and routers from above while each module remains closed to sibling implementation. A module middleware may descend to the owner base only through its one context-seeded factory; module.ts then attaches that completed value to its exact service branch.
remediate: Keep exact root contract and completed-router imports only. In module.ts, derive from the matching imported service branch through exactly ../../impl or the normalized owner alias. Author module middleware in middleware/*.middleware.ts from exactly ../../../base, importing only createMiddleware. Named router files may use one normalized ../ hop into their own module. Use normalized current-owner aliases for other root facts and same-module deep imports, and move sibling collaboration behind a service-owned capability.
message: Service modules must use normalized owner paths and remain closed to sibling implementation.
